name: maidr
description: Make every chart accessible with MAIDR (Multimodal Access and Interactive Data Representation): picks py-maidr, the maidr R package, or maidr.js for the current environment and adds keyboard navigation, screen-reader text, sonification, braille, and AI descriptions to the visual chart.

interface.longDescription: Whenever you ask for a chart, MAIDR keeps the visual exactly as designed and makes it explorable by blind and low-vision readers: arrow-key navigation through the data, screen-reader text, sonification, braille, and AI descriptions. The skill detects your environment and picks py-maidr (matplotlib, seaborn, Plotly, Altair), the maidr R package (ggplot2, base graphics), or maidr.js (D3, Chart.js, Highcharts, ECharts, Vega-Lite, hand-drawn SVG), then checks the resulting HTML with a bundled validator. The agent installs the binding it picks (pip install maidr or install.packages("maidr")) when the project lacks it; pages load maidr.js from jsDelivr or cdnjs, with a vendored copy for offline use. The plugin bundles no MCP server or hooks.
defaultPrompt: Make this chart accessible with maidr.
Plot this CSV as a bar chart that screen-reader users can explore.
Add keyboard navigation, sonification, and braille to my D3 chart.
